notes.note: This is the best we have seen from Ison since round 11. 14 disposals for him but he is bench cover only.
12 touches for Ison as he is giving mid level bench cover scores for us. Try to loop him where possible.
This was Ison's best in the last four games as he posted 13 disposals and 6 marks. He beat his BE but at best will be a bench cover for you.
Ison just isn't getting the scores we saw from him early and is not someone you can comfortably play on field.

Ison had just the 7 touches in only 67% TOG to record his lowest of the year and it has seen his BE jump to 42. With the Blues on the bye this week you could be forgiven for trading but he hasn't really made us enough cash at this point.

Ison got off to a rough start in the game with a free against but scraped to 6 touches and 3 marks. Not what we had been seeing but still he rose in value which is what we want. A new BE of -10 is still ok and hopefully he can put up a big one to keep it low.
Ison was fantastic again and could have scored better as he kicked 1.3. His BE of -77 is very attractive and he is one that will be a highly popular trade in.
Ison's debut was a very tidy one with 15 disposals and 5 marks. One more game like this and he will be a very popular downgrade option.
